title: Inspect supplemental repository policy
description: Use a disabled validation rule configured by e2e-pr-repository-policy.mts. Preview displays provider facts and supplemental policy independently.

open.intent: The operator can inspect source coverage from the shared PR dashboard.

ready.intent: The authenticated dashboard exposes the persisted rule controls.

rules.intent: Saved discovery rules remain accessible independently of review workers.

rule.intent: The isolated rule's preview control is reachable in the inventory.

preview.intent: The operator resumes the rule's saved source traversal without enabling it.

progress.intent: Provider review facts and configured inactivity are shown without claiming merge readiness.

capture.intent: Record the real repository policy assessment in the preview.

show.intent: Supplemental policy summaries are readable alongside their source facts.

available.intent: An in-progress provider read completes before another preview resumes its checkpoint.
